svg.title: agent-memory-reliability: functional architecture
svg.desc: Left: the runtime stack from agents through an MCP server and the protocol boundary to systems under test and their stores. Right: the conformance pipeline from the specification through property tests, the runner, results, and consumers. A protocol bus connects the two.
svg.text: agent-memory-reliability — functional architecture
A trust layer between agents and storage (left), and the conformance suite that checks any implementation of it (right).
RUNTIME
the layer, and what sits above and below it
CONFORMANCE
the spec as executable checks, and where the results go
Agents and clients
Any agent framework · Claude Agent SDK scenarios · any MCP-compatible client
Scenarios record a trace once; the suite replays it, so no model runs at test time.
Agents write memories with a declared confidence and cite what they derived from.
mcp/server.py — MCP server (stdio)
Ten tools mirroring the protocol (memory_write, memory_get, memory_provenance, memory_forget, …).
Translates only; decides nothing.
Saw which records it returned, so it can attribute a write's sources itself.
amr/protocol.py — the interface (MemorySystem protocol)
write · get · provenance · effective_confidence · descendants
revise · revisions · forget · list_scope · grant · revoke · grants
Record, Chain, ChainNode, ForgetReceipt, RevisionReceipt, Capabilities.
ForgetMode {tombstone, cascade, erase} · ReadOutcome {ok, not_found, forgotten}
Signatures and data shapes only — no behaviour lives here. Stdlib only; imports no system.
effective = min(declared, chain.min) — min(∅) is a declared capability.
systems/reference/ — reference impl
store.py · confidence.py · forget.py
scope.py · system.py — dict-backed, stdlib only
Capabilities: tombstone | cascade | erase
default tombstone · empty chain = 1.0
revision logged · scopes native
cross-scope = opaque ancestor · round-trip
systems/<yours>/ — your impl
Wraps your product and its store into the twelve
operations and publishes its own Capabilities.
In-tree, or external via entry point group
amr.systems — this repo never names you.
DIVERGENCE is judged against what you declare.
Store: in-memory dict, JSON round-trip
Proves the chain survives a reopen (P1.5).
Store: yours
pgvector, OpenSearch, SQLite… a store is not a system.
SPEC.md — the contract
Four properties: P1 provenance walk · P2 confidence cascade · P3 forget · P4 isolation
26 numbered checks · capability declaration (§8) · result states PASS / FAIL / DIVERGENCE (§9)
properties/ — one test per check id
test_p1_provenance · test_p2_confidence · test_p3_forget · test_p4_isolation
conftest.py parameterises every test over (system × forget_mode); fresh instance per test.
test_spec_coverage.py — a check id in SPEC.md with no test is itself a failure.
P2.5 is one signed comparison, effective_after ≤ effective_before, no branch on mode.
repros imported by the suite
taxonomy/ — named failure modes
erasure-inflation — open
silent-chain-truncation — handled by P1.6
orphaned-derivative — handled by P3.3
undeclared-derivation — out of scope
Each embeds the repro the suite runs,
asserted byte-identical.
amr/registry.py — discovery
Finds systems under test:
· in-tree: systems/*/ register on import
· external: entry points, group amr.systems
SYSTEMS=… filters a run.
Each system brings its Capabilities;
every declared mode is run.
amr/runner.py — one pytest session over every (system, forget_mode)
Outcome per check: PASS · FAIL · DIVERGENCE. A skipped or unrun check is FAIL.
Missing check ids fail the run as a harness defect, never silently.
DIVERGENCE only when SPEC.md leaves the behaviour open (§6.4) and the system's
Capabilities declare that behaviour. Reported, not scored: it never turns the build red.
results/<date>/ — the record
raw.json (schema 0.1): timestamp, git SHA, Python, platform, Capabilities, every check's outcome + detail.
summary.md: checks as rows, forget modes as columns, plus a compact matrix with P2.5 called out.
One volatile field (generated_at). Same tree → byte-identical bytes.
make determinism — enforced in CI
Two subprocess runs into two temp dirs; raw.json and summary.md byte-compared, timestamp excluded.
PYTHONHASHSEED left unpinned so ordering bugs surface instead of hiding. Any difference fails the build.
Also gated in CI: stdlib-only AST walk over the reference, an LLM-import grep, ruff.
Results go two places: the README matrix (reproduce fails if it drifts) and a per-commit CI artifact.
tests target the protocol
runner drives systems
Load-bearing properties of this design
• No LLM in the measurement path: agent runs produce traces that are checked in and replayed, so the verdict never depends on a model.
• Strict writes: a source id that does not resolve is rejected, never silently dropped — a dropped ancestor shortens the chain and inflates confidence exactly like erasure.
• One edge type, derived-from. Judgments about conflict or agreement are records derived from what they judge, so the arithmetic stays defensible and acyclic.

• DIVERGENCE is a property of a system's declaration, not of the check: a system that resolves min(∅) differently passes P2.5 without any test being edited. The reference imports only the standard library.
